en: A sepia‑toned, early photograph print mounted on a postcard backing showing a quiet townscape with cobblestone streets and low, tiled‑roof houses in the foreground. A few pedestrians walk along the main street to the left. In the middle and far distance stand several larger, neoclassical public buildings with symmetrical facades and many windows. Behind the town, low hills form the horizon. The top margin of the card is blank except for a red guideline and a handwritten number or symbol in the upper left.
